verdict.rationale: Graphite Chat is documented to let developers ask questions, get explanations, request summaries, suggested fixes, and CI diagnostics directly on the PR page with contextual awareness (docs-6,7,8,15,21), matching the story's 'reply to reviewer for questions/commands, answered in context' theme. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that replies work as a true threaded conversation with the reviewer bot (community evidence only discusses stacking/CLI, not chat interactions), and no evidence of command execution beyond suggested fixes.
